2026_01_BUF_HOU.headline: Buffalo’s Allen-led offense faces Houston’s healthiest defensive test
2026_01_BUF_HOU.paragraph1: Buffalo opens in Houston with Josh Allen available but Ty Johnson, Jordan Hancock and T.J. Sanders carrying injury concerns, while the Texans entered the matchup with a comparatively clean report. Houston’s path is to disrupt protection and force Buffalo to string together patient drives instead of living on Allen’s improvisation. The Bills can answer by staying efficient before third down and using Allen’s movement selectively rather than letting Houston dictate obvious passing situations.
2026_01_BUF_HOU.model_rationale: Buffalo owns the higher offensive ceiling, but Houston can tighten the matchup by winning protection downs, limiting scramble explosives and forcing longer, mistake-free possessions.
